seo.title: ODDference — where creative expertise meets business and society
seo.description: A professional conference built around one question: what can business and wider society learn from creative expertise?

title: What can business learn from creative expertise?
intro: ODDference is a professional conference built around one question: what can business and wider society learn from creative expertise? The programme starts from knowledge developed through creative practice and puts the people behind that work in conversation with leaders, organisations and decision-makers from elsewhere.

features.title: Talks & panels
features.body: Creative practitioners, business leaders, founders, researchers and policymakers looking at the same questions from different directions.

features.title: Matchmaking
features.body: Structured time built into the day to meet people you wouldn't otherwise cross paths with.

features.title: Straight into ODDfest
features.body: ODDference runs straight into the wider ODDfest programme — the conversation continues past the closing session.

bigQuestion.headline: What can business and the rest of society learn from creative expertise?
bigQuestion.body: Creative professionals spend their careers working with uncertainty, attention, culture, meaning, aesthetics, audiences and ideas that do not have a playbook yet. Those questions increasingly matter far beyond the creative fields. ODDference is a place to examine what that expertise can teach the rest of us — and what happens when the people carrying it are in the room.

whoItsFor.label: Business leaders
whoItsFor.description: For people making decisions where there is no ready-made playbook — and who want perspectives from outside the usual business circuit.

whoItsFor.label: Organisational leaders
whoItsFor.description: For people working on culture, change and organisations where human behaviour matters as much as process.

whoItsFor.label: Entrepreneurs
whoItsFor.description: For people building something that does not exist yet and looking for better ways to work with uncertainty.

whoItsFor.label: Policymakers
whoItsFor.description: For people shaping cities, funding, regulation and institutions — and who need direct contact with the people affected by those decisions.

whoItsFor.label: Creative leaders
whoItsFor.description: For creative leaders who want to take part in the wider conversations where culture, business and society are being shaped.

whyAttend.title: New perspectives
whyAttend.body: Leave with a genuinely different way of thinking about a problem you brought in, not just a stack of slides.

whyAttend.title: Relevant connections
whyAttend.body: Meet people solving adjacent problems from a completely different discipline.

whyAttend.title: Practical ideas
whyAttend.body: Talks and sessions built to translate into something you can actually use, not just admire.

themes.title: Creative leadership
themes.body: What organisational leadership can learn from how creative teams actually make decisions under uncertainty.

themes.title: Culture & attention
themes.body: How cultural relevance, storytelling and audience attention actually work — and what that means for brands, cities and institutions.

themes.title: Creative economy & technology
themes.body: Where creative practice, new technology and economic models are colliding right now, and what's worth paying attention to.

connection.headline: The people in the room are part of the programme.
connection.body: The stage is only part of the day. ODDference leaves real time for introductions, small-group conversations, shared meals and the kind of unplanned encounter that is hard to manufacture once everyone goes home.
